articles.title: Bitcoin whales bought $16.7 billion of bitcoin in 2 weeks even as ETFs bled a record $4 billion
articles.snippet: U.S. institutional demand had its worst month ever in June. Large holders absorbed the selling, marking a divergence that has shown up near past cycle bottoms.

articles.title: Tokenization could make finance faster, but also more susceptible to shocks, IMF says
articles.snippet: Tokenization could make finance faster and cheaper. It also makes it more vulnerable to sudden shocks, the International Monetary Fund said.

articles.title: Finally. $221 million flow into Bitcoin ETFs, ending a painful 10-day outflow streak
articles.snippet: Spot ETFs had their strongest inflow day in two months, driven by funds other than BlackRock’s IBIT.

articles.title: US Treasury sanctions over 100 ISIS-K crypto addresses that moved over $1.4 million
articles.snippet: ISIS-K allegedly used its media wing to solicit donations via Tron, Monero, and Bitcoin, highlighting stablecoin issuers' growing role in sanctions enforcement.

articles.title: FBI director discloses Strategy holdings months after deadline: Report
articles.snippet: Strategy is a registered US government contractor, though Kash Patel claimed that “no current conflict exists” with his $100,001 and $250,000 worth of the company’s stock that he reported late.
